subject: Post-demo: deployment alignment and HIPAA evidence checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medalign.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: deployment alignment and HIPAA evidence checklist

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and helpful context on MedAlign's workflows. Per our demo, I pulled together a short recap and the specific questions we need to qualify recommended deployment paths (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem).

Recap (short):
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference into patient-facing triage and clinician-assist flows with PHI in prompts and outputs.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-covered PHI, vendor BAA required, audit logs for 12+ months, and preference for customer-managed encryption if possible.

What we recommend you consider (high-level):
- Hosted API + BAA: quickest path to production; we can sign a BAA and provide SOC2 attestation. Good if you accept vendor-managed KMS and don't require on-prem isolation.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs): predictable throughput, tenant isolation, SLA options. Supports longer retention and stronger networking controls; suitable if you need throughput guarantees and stronger contractual SLAs.
- Private VPC / On-prem: for the strictest compliance/residency requirements — full control over networking and keys. Longer onboarding and procurement lead time.

Clarifying questions we need from you to finalize a recommendation (please reply inline):
1) What % of inference traffic will contain PHI vs non-PHI? (ballpark okay)
2) Required retention for data and audit logs (days/months)? Any legal hold expectations?
3) Is customer-managed KMS (BYOK) a firm requirement, or is vendor-managed KMS with envelope encryption acceptable?
4) Will MedAlign require on-site audits or just third-party attestation (SOC2 report + BAA)?
5) Procurement timeline / target go-live date? Do you have a contract template or standard terms we should review?

Attachments: SOC2_Summary_v2.pdf (summary of Redwood's SOC2 scope) and Redwood_Dedicated_SLA.pdf (example SLA for Dedicated capacity).

Proposed next steps:
- Karthik will follow with a ballpark Dedicated pricing sheet and a proposed mutual action plan.
- Grace can run an eligibility check for BYOK and BAA scope and confirm what evidence we can provide.
- Schedule a 45-min procurement + security call next week to align on contract and scope.

If you can answer the five clarifying items above, we'll produce a short recommendation and an initial procurement pack (pricing band + timelines).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

--

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medalign.com>

Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@medalign.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment alignment and HIPAA evidence checklist

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary and the materials. Quick answers inline below.

1) PHI percentage: roughly 60% of API calls will include identifiable PHI fields (IDs, notes, some free text).
2) Retention: we need audit logs retained for 12 months; clinical content retention is 30 days by default but could be longer during pilot.
3) KMS: strong preference for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production; vendor-managed is OK for a limited pilot if we isolate PHI.
4) Audits: Procurement needs Redwood's SOC2 Type II report and a signed BAA. On-site audits are possible but would be a later ask (6–12 months post-prod).
5) Timeline: procurement would like a decision by end of Q2 (target pilot start early Q3). We can share our procurement checklist/PO terms after this call.

Also: can Dedicated support BYOK? And is a Private VPC option available for an initial PoC or is that multi-month? Lastly, can you provide a ballpark monthly cost for a Dedicated baseline (enough for ~200 reqs/min)?

Happy to jump back on a call — are you available Thurs 3/18 morning?

Thanks,
Sarah Patel
Head of Integrations | MedAlign
sarah.patel@medalign.com | (212) 555-0190

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks for the quick responses. Based on what you shared, here is a proposed path and immediate asks so procurement/security can keep moving: 

Summary recommendation (short):
- Pilot: Hosted API with a scoped BAA + data isolation controls (vendor-managed KMS acceptable for pilot) — fastest to start and allows us to validate workflows in 2–4 weeks.
- Production: Dedicated capacity with BYOK (customer-managed KMS) and 12-month audit log retention — provides necessary contractual SLAs and stronger network isolation.
- Private VPC / On-prem: available if procurement requires full tenant isolation or residency rules; lead time typically 8–12 weeks and we can scope in parallel with the pilot.

Immediate deliverables attached: SOC2_Summary_v2.pdf, Redwood_Dedicated_SLA.pdf, Dedicated_pricing_range.xlsx (ballpark monthly ranges for ~200 reqs/min).

Action items (mutual action plan):
1) MedAlign: share PO terms and any non-negotiable contract clauses; confirm if BYOK is a gating item for pilot. (Due: 2027-03-22)
2) Redwood (Karthik): provide detailed Dedicated pricing, BYOK technical note, and evidence pack (network diagrams, tenant isolation summary, SOC2 attestation). (Due: 2027-03-22)
3) Joint: procurement + security call to review evidence and draft BAA language. Schedule: proposed Thu 3/18 at 10:00 AM PT (45 min).

Questions for MedAlign to confirm:
- Is on-site audit capability required in the contract up front, or can we defer to standard SOC2 + BAA with a clause for future on-site audits?
- Any specific regulatory requirements beyond HIPAA (state-level, EU residency, etc.)?

I can run the technical deep-dive and Grace will own the evidence pack. Marissa will coordinate scheduling and commercial terms. If the proposed Thu 3/18 10:00 AM PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite and the meeting agenda + doc links.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scoped.

Best,
